task.title: Source-backed Task Attempt and telemetry read model

runtimeObservationLimitations: No process command terminal outcome or exit code
No raw payload/candidate SHA/token cost in public observation envelopes
publicApiReality.publicJournal: HarnessExecutionJournalStore.read(slot) is point lookup; no list/scan
publicApiReality.publicEffectJournal: NodeSqliteAdmissionEffectJournal.getEffect(effectId) is point lookup; no public list

implementationContract: Use the existing selected K/Host public observation reader to reconstruct lifecycle with exact WorkflowAddress, immutable package identity, epoch, contiguous sequence and high-watermark.

Host supplies a bounded authoritative Task→Attempt identity roster/index and point read for attempt-specific source SHA, Agent, environment/worktree/target, outcome, candidate/ref and restart lineage; no invented private fallback.

Separate observed runtime lifecycle, selected Host execution receipt, native GitHub ADS report, independent review/CI/hidden/full/RQ proof and optional task-meta metrics into distinct typed evidence classes.
Source monotonicity: exact repository/version/Task/Attempt/source SHA, event identity and correction/supersession; no silent overwrite or false reuse after restart.
Project read-only Business projection through five owned paths; no UI/serve/main mount, package root ABI expansion, new K/second database, or claim publisher.

UNKNOWN and PARTIAL propagate loss of public observations, incomplete cursor, unavailable reports/telemetry, unavailable Host roster and incoherent evidence. Core Task/Release never blocked solely on missing task-meta.

Final #261 B consumer connects the existing Task/Agent UI in its own write set; #264 alone mounts the shared installed Host/API and verifies J01-J08 and V evidence. This Pack is not proof of that integration.

positive: Stable Task/Attempt roster maps to independent Host/public-K observations with correct package/epoch/source identity and bounded cursor.
Interrupted Agent Attempt followed by restart preserves both original and recovered history with exact event linkage.
Native ADS correction/revision readback and independent reviewer/CI prove observed outcome separately from Agent status.
Missing optional telemetry produces metric UNKNOWN/NOT_COMPARABLE with positive coverage denominator while main Task read path remains available.

negative.name: WRONG_REPO
negative.expected: Repo mismatch denies and never leaks foreign Task data

negative.name: WRONG_VERSION_OR_TASK
negative.expected: Version/Task/Attempt identity mismatch returns UNKNOWN or BLOCKED

negative.name: SOURCE_DRIFT
negative.expected: Stale selected SHA, package, epoch or commit cannot be accepted as current

negative.name: DUP_ATTEMPT_ID
negative.expected: Duplicate or contradictory Attempt facts do not overwrite append-only history

negative.name: MALFORMED_EVENT
negative.expected: Malformed/out-of-order event yields incomplete UNKNOWN with provenance

negative.name: MISSING_RUNTIME_ADDRESS
negative.expected: Unknown WorkflowAddress/package/epoch must not be treated as zero attempts

negative.name: OBSERVATION_GAP
negative.expected: Public observation retention/storage/cursor gap maps to INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN

negative.name: OBSERVATION_NOT_TERMINAL
negative.expected: TURN_COMMITTED is not proof of real Agent exit or independently verified PASS

negative.name: NO_PUBLIC_INDEX
negative.expected: If Host has only point lookup and no bounded trusted Attempt enumeration, fail closed, do not scan private SQLite

negative.name: NO_EFFECT_SETTLED
negative.expected: RuntimeObservation v1 does not expose EFFECT_SETTLED or process-command outcome; deny invented candidate SHA/exit code

negative.name: ADS_REPORT_MISSING
negative.expected: Missing ADS v5/task-meta report remains UNKNOWN; Task execution is not blocked

negative.name: METRICS_ABSENT
negative.expected: Null timing/token/cost not mapped to 0; coverage denominator explicit

negative.name: METRICS_NOT_COMPARABLE
negative.expected: Different measured scopes never become a false uplift/comparison

negative.name: SELF_REPORTED_PASS
negative.expected: Agent self-report never upgrades independent review/CI/Hidden/RQ to PASS

negative.name: SENSITIVE_PAYLOAD
negative.expected: Credential/private report/raw Trace/hidden fixtures stripped; no private task-meta query

negative.name: RESTART_RECOVERY
negative.expected: Interruption, restart and recovery preserve distinct immutable attempts

negative.name: HTTP_MUTATION
negative.expected: Read-only adapter refuses POST, Claim, dispatch or GitHub write; no side effects

negative.name: MIXED_REVISION
negative.expected: K/Host event and ADS report source identities differ: conflict or partial, never silently join
